# Two `open` lines whose account names have an empty part.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets and Assets:Bank, and two refusals. `open ""`
# gives no name at all, and `open Assets::Savings` gives an empty name between
# Assets and Savings. Neither is an account GnuCash can hold under a name, so
# neither is created.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_account_is_not_opened_without_a_name.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open ""
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets::Savings
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
